info.text:
Same 8 stops in London. In a random order you'd walk about 22.1 km. In the shortest order, 9.6 km.

1. Buckingham Palace
2. Westminster Abbey
3. Big Ben
4. Trafalgar Square
5. British Museum
6. St Paul's Cathedral
7. Tower of London
8. Tower Bridge

📌 Save this order for your trip.

Travelhour puts the places you swipe into walking order and guides you there. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/travelhour-trip-planner/id6773093615

#londontravel #londonitinerary #walkingtour

Distances are estimates: straight line between stops plus 30% for streets.
